mutants.description: Validation rule `Discount_Max` on Opportunity inverted: it now blocks valid records and lets invalid ones through

mutants.diff:
--- a/main/default/objects/Opportunity/validationRules/Discount_Max.validationRule-meta.xml

@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
     <fullName>Discount_Max</fullName>
     <active>true</active>
     <description>Discounts above 40% are not allowed (Mutant demo app).</description>
-    <errorConditionFormula>Discount_Percent__c > 0.40</errorConditionFormula>
+    <errorConditionFormula>NOT( Discount_Percent__c > 0.40 )</errorConditionFormula>

     <errorMessage>Discount cannot exceed 40%.</errorMessage>

@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
